design.pairing: teacher rows sorted within cue by sequenceIndex,round to physical receiver repeats 6-28 in ordinal order
design.featureNormalization: three archived fixed standardized MBON features; measured DN counts / 7.388888888888889
design.classifier: class-balanced weighted ridge one-hot linear scores, intercept unpenalized, L2=1, argmax lowest-index tie
design.controls: cue-only majority B; zero-Q forced bit0; fixed cue-stratified within-partition bit permutation
design.gates: strategy balanced >=80%, +20pp over MBON/shuffled/untrained, each cue >=75%; direct action balanced >=60%, +10pp over MBON/shuffled/untrained, each cue >=50%; both receiver folds required

limitations: Source and receiver recordings are paired offline, not simultaneous teacher-student trials.
Source teachers and receiver probes were previously characterized; this is not an untouched independent confirmation.
Receiver branches are reused across teachers; fold-level receiver seed and teacher groups are disjoint, but effective physical sample size is limited.
The two receiver folds share teacher partitions and are not statistically independent.
Direct linear action scores have no cue-by-message interaction, which can limit representation of the cyclic RPS rule.
Supervised offline labels never enter the simulated student and cannot establish reward-based teaching.
